text:
maria: hey team — I'm hunting logs for a customer report. I have request_id=8c2a9f4b but console search returns zero hits. Tried last 30m. Any quick pointers?

devon: first check: is that value in X-Request-ID header or in our x-request-ref field? console query differs. try both as exact phrase: request_id:"8c2a9f4b" OR "x-request-ref:8c2a9f4b"

maria: it's from an Sentry span trace (trace=ab12cd34). The header name might be different when it crossed the edge.

samir: if you have the trace id, open Traces -> find trace ab12cd34 -> click the edge span, there's a field called span.link or request_ref in the span tags. that gives the exact header we should grep for in logs.

devon: quick CLI steps if console still hides it:
```
# tail recent logs for ingress proxy and filter\stern ingress-proxy -n prod --container=proxy '8c2a9f4b' --since 30m
# or using kubectl if you know the pod\kubectl logs -n prod pod/my-ingress-pod -c proxy --tail=500 | rg 8c2a9f4b
```

maria: tried stern, got nothing. samir — where else could the id be transformed?

samir: two common things: 1) our edge rewrites to `x-req-ref` lowercased, or 2) request id is attached as part of JSON payload in backend logs (so not a header). Try a fuzzy console search for the last 8 chars: "9f4b" with a narrow time window. also check trace sampling: if span was sampled but logs were not emitted at that time, you won't find a match.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: ingress-proxy v2 rolled out yesterday 05:12 UTC — some header names changed (x-request-ref -> x-rd-req). Keep that in mind. :information_source:

ashley: another thing — our log indexer tiers cold storage after 24h; if this is older you need raw S3 bucket access. but since it's recent, focus on edge and app pods for 5 minutes around trace timestamp.

devon: if you find the span id but not request header, use our trace->req lookup script: `/scripts/trace_to_request.sh <trace_id>` (on bastion). It prints candidate request ids and approximate pods. Example output:
```
$ /scripts/trace_to_request.sh ab12cd34
possible: x-rd-req=8c2a9f4b pod=app-frontend-2
```

maria: running that now on bastion... ok it returned x-rd-req=8c2a9f4b and pod hint. thanks. I'll tail that pod logs and report back.

samir: if it still doesn't show, DM me the trace id and I'll check trace sampling and any proxy rewrite rules. also we should update the console saved query to include x-rd-req variants.

maria: will do. also opening a quick follow-up: can we add a short docs blurb about the header rename so oncall knows which header to search? low effort but saves time.

ashley: +1 — I'll add a note in the observability cookbook and a saved query in Console: `request_id_any:(request_id OR x-request-id OR x-rd-req OR x-req-ref)`

maria: perfect — thanks all, found the log lines via the pod hint. closing the hunt. :tada:
